findings.note: He filed Senate bill 498, a petition for legislation on Election Day registration at polling places. The text (https://malegislature.gov/Bills/194/S498.html) lets an eligible person register on election day at the polling place by completing a form that meets the identity requirements of the federal Help America Vote Act, showing proof of residency and signing an oath of citizenship.
